summary: The implementation provides comprehensive focus session functionality with timer, violation tracking, grayscale warnings, and content locking. All core requirements are implemented with frontend hooks, UI components, and backend storage. However, there are several missing implementation details related to violation counter resets, clear user feedback indicators, and specific completion scenarios.

missing_requirements.requirement: User receives clear indication that counter has reset
missing_requirements.reason: While the violation counter resets to 0 after the grayscale period (implemented in useFocusSessionViolations.ts), there is no visible toast notification or UI indicator explicitly informing the user that the counter has been reset and a new cycle has started

missing_requirements.requirement: Clear option is presented to start a new focus session with fresh duration selection
missing_requirements.reason: The FocusSession page shows session summary on completion, but the diff is truncated and does not show the explicit UI button or clear call-to-action for starting a new session after completion

hallucinated_features.description: Focus score calculation and display with percentage-based performance metrics
hallucinated_features.reason: The implementation includes a focus score calculation (100 - violationCount * 10) and displays it prominently in the FocusSessionSummary component, but this scoring system was not requested in the BuildRequest requirements

hallucinated_features.description: Warning cycle counter tracking and display
hallucinated_features.reason: The implementation tracks and displays 'warningCycles' (number of times the grayscale warning was triggered), but this metric was not requested in the requirements, which only specified that cycles repeat indefinitely

The useFocusSessionTimer hook includes pauseSession and resumeSession functions, but the requirements only mentioned reset/start new session capabilities when timer completes, not mid-session pause/resume
